note: Two lists, read by two different checks. Do not move an entry between them. `functions` is the source gate (scripts/check-anon-rpc-grants.mjs): functions in the public schema that OUR MIGRATIONS deliberately leave executable by anon or by PUBLIC. That list is exact, so an entry with no matching grant in the migrations fails as stale. `snapshot_objects` is the live catalog check (scripts/check-anon-acl-snapshot.mjs): objects a refreshed catalog snapshot shows reachable by anon, authenticated or PUBLIC on purpose. Most of those grants were never written by a migration, they are inherited from the schema default privileges, so they must NOT go in `functions`, where they would fail as stale entries by construction. Empty is the correct state for both. Adding a key to either is a security decision, not a formatting fix: it says that reach is intended. Paste the key the failing check prints rather than hand typing it, because the match is exact and case sensitive. The value is the reason, one line, in plain English.
